# Appearance › Themes swatch cards — evidence (W4c, agent C)

Offscreen software renders (Qt `offscreen`, real shell services and theme
roles, isolated XDG tree; not desktop captures, not QA-VM). The real
`ThemesSection` is rendered with a stub preview controller that only exposes
`paletteForTheme`, so nothing is applied. Cards show the three built-in
Signal themes; catalogue themes appear the same way when the registry lists a
schema-v2 palette or swatch (legacy Material-seed packs are omitted).
Themes: `night`, `day`, `hc` (Signal High Contrast).
